0022600103.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-1), 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West, host the Portland Trail Blazers (1-0), who are 2nd in the Northwest and 4th in the West, in the Kings' second game of the 2026-27 season. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and Portland is without Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle, soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Kings lost 0-4 to Portland in 2025-26, most recently 122-110 in Portland on April 12, 2026.
